edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller of transfer and is forwarded as the from address of _transfer.
transfer invokes the internal _transfer routine.
_transfer performs an external ETH transfer to the marketing wallet before finishing state updates.
_transfer triggers a router swap when swap conditions with block.timestamp hold.
block.timestamp controls cooldown enforcement and auto-swap scheduling inside _transfer.
_transfer delegates final balance updates to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer consumes the fee amounts returned by _getValues.
_tokenTransfer mutates _rOwned and _rTotal reflection balances.
swapTokensForEth performs the router swap call.
manualLiquidity swaps half the contract token balance for ETH.
manualLiquidity forwards the contract ETH balance to addLiquidityETH.
liquify adds liquidity through the router using the whole ETH balance.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the marketing wallet.
manualsend transfers an arbitrary ETH amount to the marketing wallet.
manualswap routes the request through swapTokensForEth.
openTrading creates the uniswap pair via the factory.
openTrading seeds initial liquidity via addLiquidityETH.
setSwap only proceeds when msg.sender equals _BATL_Wallet.
manualswap only proceeds when msg.sender equals _BATL_Wallet.
manualsend only proceeds when msg.sender equals _BATL_Wallet.
manualLiquidity only proceeds when msg.sender equals _BATL_Wallet.
setQty only proceeds when msg.sender equals _BATL_Wallet.
setQty rewrites the swapQty threshold controlling automatic swaps.
setMaxTxAmount is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing caller identity.
setBots is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
delBot is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setCooldownEnabled is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
constructor derives the initial owner from _msgSender.
constructor assigns the whole reflection supply to the deployer.
_transfer credits reflection tokens to a hardcoded address when the timestamp parity branch is taken.
_getValues computes fees from the mutable _BATL_Fee and _LIQ_Fee values.
_transfer overwrites the _BATL_Fee state variable.
_transfer overwrites the _LIQ_Fee state variable.
_transfer reschedules _nextSwap using block.timestamp arithmetic.
_transfer writes the cooldown mapping based on block.timestamp.
cooldown entries are compared and assigned using the current block.timestamp.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
approve calls the internal _approve helper.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
setBots marks addresses in the bots mapping.
delBot clears an entry in the bots mapping.
_transfer reads the bots mapping to block flagged addresses.
The ETH transfer to a payable wallet can re-enter the token before _transfer completes.
The router/pair swap can call back into the token contract during _transfer.
from parameter flows into the internal _transfer logic.
to parameter determines whether the pair or a user is the recipient.
amount parameter drives all fee and cooldown computations.
tAmount parameter is the base of the reflection arithmetic in _tokenTransfer.
currentRate local feeds the reflection amount calculations.
_tokens parameter is scaled and swapped by manualswap.
_qty parameter is written into the swapQty threshold.
maxTxAmount parameter is stored into _maxTxAmount after scaling.
bots_ array parameter is iterated to populate the bots mapping.
walletAddress parameter replaces the payable marketing wallet.
contractTokenBalance local drives the swap and liquidity branch selection.
onoff parameter toggles the cooldownEnabled flag.
notbot parameter is used to clear the bot flag.
path local array is passed to the router swap call.

normalization_plan.reason: param_from is a parameter of _transfer and carries no independent semantics.
param_to is a parameter of _transfer used only for fee branch selection.
param_amount is a parameter of _transfer driving fee and cooldown logic.
param_tAmount is the direct arithmetic input of _tokenTransfer.
local_currentRate is produced by _getRate and consumed by _getValues.
param_tokens is the sole input of manualswap.
param_qty is the sole input of setQty.
param_maxTxAmount is the sole input of setMaxTxAmount.
param_bots_ is the sole input of setBots.
param_walletAddress is the sole input of setMarketingWallet.
local_contractTokenBalance is computed and consumed entirely inside _transfer.
param_onoff is the sole input of setCooldownEnabled.
param_notbot is the sole input of delBot.
local_path is constructed and consumed inside swapTokensForEth.
